title: Admitted Python live page and exact tagged values
question: Can Python project an already admitted page without repeating depth-sensitive validation?
method: Compare current raw projection and the draft admitted-page handoff on equal synthetic values, check direct tag and decimal boundaries, and exercise the independent native read and wire/cut controls on the isolated draft.

conclusion: Admitted-page handoff removes measured depth amplification in the projection step and passes the exact read-budget case. Keep strict raw ingress and exact cut checks. The private run and pre-change watchdog differ in source and context, so no end-to-end speedup is claimed.
